# 3rdparty CMakelists.txt
set(THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER "3rdparty")

if(NOT TARGET assimp::assimp)
    # Local Assimp v6.0.3 trimmed to enabled formats; see assimp/SOURCE.md.
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_ALL_IMPORTERS_BY_DEFAULT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_GLTF_IMPORTER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_OBJ_IMPORTER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_NO_EXPORT ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_ASSIMP_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_SAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_DRACO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_ZLIB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_IGNORE_GIT_HASH ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_INJECT_DEBUG_POSTFIX OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_HUNTER_ENABLED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_USD_IMPORTER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_VRML_IMPORTER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_M3D_IMPORTER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_BUILD_NONFREE_C4D_IMPORTER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ASSIMP_OPT_BUILD_PACKAGES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(USE_STATIC_CRT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(assimp)
    set_target_properties(assimp PROPERTIES FOLDER "3rdparty/assimp")
    set_target_properties(zlibstatic PROPERTIES FOLDER "3rdparty/assimp")
endif()

# stb_image: PNG memory decoding, private to Runtime
if(NOT TARGET stb_image)
    add_subdirectory(stb)
endif()

# fmt (placed before spdlog so external fmt is available)
if(NOT TARGET fmt)
    add_subdirectory(fmt-12.1.0)
    set_target_properties(fmt PROPERTIES FOLDER ${THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER}/fmt)
endif()

# spdlog (force using external fmt)
if(NOT TARGET spdlog)
    option(SPDLOG_FMT_EXTERNAL "Use external fmt" ON)
    option(SPDLOG_FMT_EXTERNAL_HO "" OFF)
    option(SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE "" OFF)
    option(SPDLOG_INSTALL "" OFF)
    if(WIN32)
        # Engine paths are UTF-8; open native Windows paths through spdlog's wide API.
        set(SPDLOG_WCHAR_FILENAMES ON CACHE BOOL "Use native Windows filenames" FORCE)
    endif()
    add_subdirectory(spdlog-1.16.0)
    set_target_properties(spdlog PROPERTIES FOLDER ${THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER}/spdlog)
endif()

# google test
if(NOT TARGET gtest AND NOT TARGET gmock)
    option(BUILD_GTEST "" ON)
    option(BUILD_GMOCK "" ON)
    add_subdirectory(googletest-1.15.0)
    set_target_properties(gtest PROPERTIES FOLDER ${THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER}/gtest)
    set_target_properties(gmock PROPERTIES FOLDER ${THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER}/gtest)
    set_target_properties(gtest_main PROPERTIES FOLDER ${THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER}/gtest)
    set_target_properties(gmock_main PROPERTIES FOLDER ${THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER}/gtest)
endif()

# glfw
if(NOT TARGET glfw)
    option(GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES "" OFF)
    option(GLFW_BUILD_TESTS "" OFF)
    option(GLFW_BUILD_DOCS "" OFF)
    add_subdirectory(glfw)
    set_target_properties(glfw PROPERTIES FOLDER ${THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER}/glfw)
endif()

# imgui
if(NOT TARGET imgui)
    add_subdirectory(imgui-1.91.9b)
    set_target_properties(imgui PROPERTIES FOLDER ${THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER}/imgui)
endif()

# vulkan
if(WIN32)
    add_subdirectory(vulkan)
    set_target_properties(vulkan PROPERTIES FOLDER ${THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER}/vulkan)
endif()

# utfcpp (仅头文件 UTF-8 库)
if(NOT TARGET utf8::utf8cpp)
    add_subdirectory(utfcpp)
    set_target_properties(utf8cpp PROPERTIES FOLDER ${THIRD_PARTY_FOLDER}/utfcpp)
endif()
